William Blake (1757–1827).  The Poetical Works.  1908.

On Art and Artists

A pair of stays to mend the shape

XXX
A 
PAIR
 of stays to mend the shape
Of crookèd humpy woman,
Put on, O Venus; now thou art
Quite a Venetian Roman.
